_comment: The hosted page's OAuth client IDs (docs/web-deploy.md § Web sign-in). Public values: React's hosted build carries the same Google ID. Google's console must list https://admin.invoicing.co as an authorized JavaScript origin. Microsoft stays empty on hosted (decided 2026-11-15: hosted Microsoft users use Invoice Ninja Web); a self-hosted server's page gets its own MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID from the backend. Apple stays empty until its Services ID lists admin.invoicing.co and the server's APPLE_CLIENT_IDS accepts it. An empty ID hides the button and loads no script.
